[attribute-issue]
=== `@issue` Issue Number of a Related Article

Issue number of a journal which contains the related article.

#### Usage/Remarks
The <<attribute-issue,`@issue`>> attribute can be used, along with the <<attribute-vol,`@vol`>>, <<attribute-journal-id,`@journal-id`>>, and <<attribute-page,`@page`>> attributes, to provide the metadata for the related journal article.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The number of the journal issue, such as 
                        “`48`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
